test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

According to the politician, using vulgar language to ______ votes is not something he will endorse.
solution:
The correct answer is "**garner**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is saying that the politician does not support using vulgar language to gain votes
 
• Thus, among the given options the correct word to fill the blank is "garner."
 
• "Garner" means to gather or collect something, especially s
